# Top-Rated Team — ai.top-rated.team

> Paid advertising, the measurement under it, and the custom AI around both.
> Six offers a visitor can read here, and one room behind all of them. Every
> offer names the company that signs the contract and sends the invoice. None
> of them publishes a price.

This is the short index. llms-full.txt beside it is the same material at
length. Both are written by scripts/build-llms.ts out of shared/doors.ts and
the pages themselves, so neither can describe an offer this site does not
make.

## How a visit works

- Each offer has a page of its own. Where the offer is open, that page carries
  a panel: a visitor asks a question in it, an agent answers from
  documentation and links the pages it used, and that costs nothing and does
  not need their name.
- The conversation is not saved while that is happening, and the page says so
  under the answer: nothing is saved yet, close the tab and it is gone.
- A conversation the visitor keeps becomes a room at an address of its own,
  with our agents and our people in it and no signup — the link in the browser
  is the whole account.
- Every offer below answers questions today.
- Live answers need an OpenAI key on the deployment. Without one the panel
  says they are not configured, rather than producing something shaped like an
  answer.

## Offers

- [Conversion tracking for ChatGPT Ads](https://ai.top-rated.team/services/chatgpt-ads): The one part of paid ads any AI agent still can't finish for you. Ours end to end; invoiced by Top-Rated Team (Danylo Burykin SZČO).
- [Google Ads management](https://ai.top-rated.team/services/google-ads): Search, Performance Max and Shopping, run by the people Google books to train other advertisers. Ours end to end; invoiced by Top-Rated Team (Danylo Burykin SZČO).
- [Google Ad Grants, set up through the official Google Ads API](https://ai.top-rated.team/services/ad-grants): Campaigns, ad groups, keywords, ads and extensions are generated from your own website and written into your Google Ads account through the official Google Ads API — under a manager-account link you can remove, not a tool signed in as you. Ours end to end; invoiced by Top-Rated Team (Danylo Burykin SZČO).
- [LinkedIn Ads for B2B](https://ai.top-rated.team/services/linkedin-ads): Account-based targeting, lead gen forms, the Insight Tag, and a closed loop from spend to pipeline in your CRM — so the report says revenue rather than form fills. Ours end to end; invoiced by Top-Rated Team (Danylo Burykin SZČO).
- [LinkedIn automation — with a written legal assessment](https://ai.top-rated.team/services/linkedin-automation): A qualified lawyer writes down what is and is not allowed where you are before anything runs, on their own paper. Lawyer first; invoiced by Top-Rated Team (Danylo Burykin SZČO).
- [Custom AI builds](https://ai.top-rated.team/services/ai-builds): The agent you are talking to is the thing itself: an assistant grounded in one body of knowledge, wired into one stack, that hands the work to a person where it runs out. Ours end to end; invoiced by Top-Rated Team (Danylo Burykin SZČO).

## Pages

- [Home](https://ai.top-rated.team/): what the company does, the panel, and the index of the offers.
- [The index](https://ai.top-rated.team/services): every offer above as one row, with the company that would invoice it.
- [robots.txt](https://ai.top-rated.team/robots.txt): what crawlers are asked to leave alone.
- [sitemap.xml](https://ai.top-rated.team/sitemap.xml): the addresses handed to crawlers.

## Not in this file

- Room addresses. A kept conversation lives at /w/<token>, and that token is a
  bearer credential in the URL: writing one down publishes it. robots.txt
  disallows /w/, those pages carry noindex, and this file leaves them out for
  the same reason.
- The HTTP API. robots.txt disallows /api/ as well, and this file follows it.
- Prices, budgets, timelines and promised results. No page publishes any of
  them, and the agents are instructed to say that pricing and scope come from
  a person rather than produce a figure.
- More offers than the six listed. https://ai.top-rated.team/services asks for
  an email address before it names them, they are absent from sitemap.xml, and
  their pages are noindex — so a file at the root does not name them either.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://ai.top-rated.team/llms-full.txt): every offer's full description, the agent that answers it, the questions its panel offers, the company that signs it, and the argument the conversion-tracking page makes at length.
